title: The Battle of the Books, and other Short Pieces
sourceTitle: The Battle of the Books, and other Short Pieces
author: Jonathan Swift
description: "The Battle of the Books, and other Short Pieces" by Jonathan Swift is a satire published in 1704.
longDescription: It depicts a literal battle between books in the King's Library, where ancient and modern works come alive to fight for supremacy.

authorInfo.bio: Jonathan Swift was an Anglo-Irish writer, essayist, satirist, and Anglican cleric. He was the author of the satirical prose novel Gulliver's Travels (1726) and the creator of the fictional island of Lilliput. He is regarded by many as the greatest satirist of the Georgian era and one of the foremost prose authors in the history of English and world literature.
